business_summary: Operator of Policybazaar (insurance marketplace), Paisabazaar (loans), and newer initiatives (Policybazaar for Business, UAE, health, Doctor consult). Revenue is mostly commission and marketing fees from insurers on premium sold (Q2 FY27 premium ~Rs9,385cr, +38%; revenue ~Rs2,178cr, +35%; PAT ~Rs192cr per search summaries, sources differ). IRDAI's draft commission/EoM caps and dark-pattern ban (2026-09-23/24) triggered a 36% one-day crash; stock Rs971 (-39% in 3m, -47% in 12m), market value Rs44,922cr; ad spends pressured Q2 margins (stock -7% on 2026-11-02).

revenue_mix.segment: insurance commissions and marketing fees (life, health, motor)

exposures.mechanism: IRDAI draft: product-wise commission caps (payout cap ~25%), 5-year EoM limits, dark-pattern ban, delinking of insurance from loans. PB earns ~all revenue as commission/marketing fee on insurance premium (~85-90% insurance take rate ~15-20% of premium, model). If commissions are cut a third: revenue -15 to -25%, with fixed ad/staff costs EBITDA falls ~46% (brokerages' estimate). Equity already -43% in 4 sessions (CNBC TV18/Fortune India); further downside if rules are finalised as drafted (-14 central), upside +2 if diluted (Systematix 'may need to revisit'; Livemint 2026-10-15 'not intended to disrupt').

evidence.note: PB Fintech -36% on 2026-09-24, -43% over 4 sessions; market value -Rs31,000cr; brokerages see ~46% earnings risk (Fortune India 2026-09-25); Nomura target Rs1,100 (2026-10-09), Bernstein Rs2,310 (2026-09-28)

+5 VIX points: pack beta 1.06-1.39 and 58% annual volatility; Nifty effect -1.5% x beta 1.4 + growth-stock factor => -2.5. Pack shows -0.93 per SSU (t -1.3).
Pack elasticity -5.0 per +25bp (t -1.8): long-duration growth stock; shrunk by 60% toward zero because the estimate is noisy => -2.
Pack +2.34 per +$2 GRM (t 2.8) and Brent +1.94 (t 2.1): no fundamental channel for an insurance marketplace; probable regime proxy for risk-on/inflation. Shrunk to +0.8 and left low confidence.
